_about: Everyone a slice quest places who has no quest topic of their own (owner walk 4, 2026-11-08: everyone in the places the slice quests touch has dialogue). One reply each to the prompt, built into ARG_Talk (QuestPeople in Talk.cs) gated GetIsID to the base; 'when' gates it on a quest's stage (lo inclusive, hi exclusive). Read by the echo check (tools/argonia_world/echoes.py), not the build: 'facts' lists the quest fact ids a reply states; 'speaker' names the person when a second base stands in for them elsewhere.

lines: I am Finds-The-Other-Bank. I sleep lightly and I hear every board creak in this hold. Be quiet while Ux-Xeek calls the names.
I am Finds-The-Other-Bank. Ask Llarvi Maryon about the roll. I do not know yet if what became of it is good for me.
Ri'Sakka. This one is Khajiit, a long way from the sands. This one patches the reed sleeping mats for the gang.
Ri'Sakka. This one ran when the huts burned. This one is wet and hungry.
Tsanji. This one carries the day's water. This one has seen the reeds shiver beside the path when no wind blows. Stay on the path.
Tsanji. This one carried the day's water for the gang. This one still watches the reeds beside the path.
Llarvi Maryon. I oversee this camp. I sit by the fire and I watch who comes and goes. Keep your business short, outlander.
Llarvi Maryon. The roll burned with the camp, so I cannot show what I owed. I will go back to Lilmoth and see whether the broker's men try to collect.

ARG_MQ01_WuleenSeiMarch.speaker: Wuleen-Sei
lines: We go to the camp at the edge of the paddies on Hereguard Plantation. The broker has hired you out to work there. Keep up with the gang.

ARG_MQ01_FindsTheOtherBankMarch.speaker: Finds-The-Other-Bank
lines: I am Finds-The-Other-Bank. My feet are sore from the boards of the hold. Walk where I walk. The mud is soft at the edge.
Mee-Tuja. I carry a satchel upriver. I walk with your gang as far as the camp. I will not say whose satchel it is.
I am Sal-Sei. I keep the clutch of eggs at the roots of the Hist cutting from Nine Bends. Do not go near the eggs.
I am Sal-Sei. I kept the clutch of eggs. The roots of the Hist cutting were cut before its light went out. The eggs are grey now.
I am Deesh-Duun. I mend the nets at the corner of the shed. I know every family in this camp by name. I want to be out of the broker's hire.
I am Deesh-Duun. A tall woman with a knotted cord at her wrist led the ones who attacked us. I saw her face. She let me live.
I am Nesh-Neel. I walk the yard at dusk and I check every door. Be inside your shed before the light goes.
You do not need my name. Move along.
I am Salts-The-Catch. I sell fish in Lilmoth, and I keep this house. If you were sent for, go in. If you were not, go back to the dock.
You do not know me. We take the hurt to Lilmoth by boat. Speak to the one beside me when you are ready to go.
Hides-His-Wake. I work this camp, and I do not talk about it with strangers. Go back the way you came.
Counts-The-Jars. I tend the jars of sap at this camp. You have no business here. Go.
I work for the estate. I walk this landing at night. The landing belongs to the estate. So do the boats tied to it. Keep walking.
I keep this gate for the heirs. The stone house is their outer post. Third-Born Tsaxi says who goes in. Speak to him.
I am a lookout. I watch the stair and the water. If you have business here, talk to Bent-Spine, not to me.
I am a lookout. I watch the water. If you came down the trapdoor, Bent-Spine has been told.
I walk the dock and count the crates in the ship's hold. When the keeper says go, I go.
